source_snapshot.procedure: Send one in-band Storage 0Ah/45h request followed by a record-shaped fixed payload and unresolved Sensor Type, then list SEL after clearing logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.
source_snapshot.script: DQMS link groups Add/Delete/Clear SEL operations.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL correctly withholds execution because an exact raw sequence is required.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED for an allegedly firmware-specific fragment protocol, record context, assembled-record oracle and retention/recovery policy.

old_problem: The historical review correctly recognized that the source's single record-shaped request is not a valid partial transaction, but incorrectly treated the fragment state machine as firmware-specific. IPMI 2.0 sections 31.2, 31.4, 31.5 and 31.7 standardize capability discovery, reservation, first/continuation offsets, returned Record ID, in-progress/final flags, discard on reservation cancellation and full-record readback. The exact synthetic 16-byte record, safe split and downstream containment are Project execution inputs.
disposition_reason: Use Get SEL Info to require Partial Add support, preserve the repository, obtain a Reservation ID, and send an approved synthetic 16-byte SEL record in at least two sequential 0Ah/45h fragments. The first uses Record ID 0000h, offset 00h and in-progress 0; every continuation uses the returned Record ID and the exact next offset; only the fragment that completes all 16 bytes uses final flag 1. Verify the returned Record ID with a full Get SEL Entry and exact field comparison, allowing only BMC-assigned Record ID/timestamp changes for applicable record types. Any canceled reservation, gap, overlap, wrong Record ID, mismatch or side effect fails without retry. On an incomplete sequence, one new reservation may invalidate/discard it as recovery; never append guessed fragments, clear SEL, cold-reset or substitute ordinary Add SEL.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1070-1072, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code is unique. Related OOB rows 1197-1199 were directly read; Partial Add OOB row 1198 / variant 6b619be55d9565d8 remains separate. Formal queue sequence 70 was independently verified as row 1072 / variant 256041f37676bd5f.

IPMI v2.0 Table 31-1 requires an implementation to provide Add SEL Entry or Partial Add SEL Entry; supporting both is optional. Get SEL Info Operation Support bit2 explicitly reports Partial Add support and bit1 reports Reserve SEL support.

Section 31.7/Table 31-7 defines every request field for Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd45h: reservation ID, continuation Record ID, offset, in-progress/final nibble and record bytes. This is a standard state machine, not an OEM payload.

The first fragment must use offset 00h and Record ID 0000h. Later fragments must use the Record ID returned by the controller and contiguous increasing offsets with no gap or overlap. In-progress 0 means more data; 1 means the current request contains the final record data.

A completed SEL Event Record is 16 bytes. A standard/timestamped record has its Record ID and timestamp assigned or overwritten by the SEL device, so comparison must mask only those documented fields and exactly match record type, generator/sensor/event identity and data.

The entry is not retrievable until complete. Reservation cancellation before completion discards the partial data and requires a new sequence starting at offset 00h. Since this task forbids automatic DUT-test retry, a cancellation is a recorded FAIL and the case stops.

Get SEL Info and Reserve SEL define concurrency behavior. If Reserve is implemented, the returned nonzero ID is mandatory; if the platform reports no Reserve support, 0000h is allowed only with an authoritative serialized-access package. A background SEL addition can cancel an active reservation.

The source payload begins with bytes that 0Ah/45h interprets as reservation, Record ID, offset and final flag, leaving only ten record-data bytes; it has no preceding reservation and cannot assemble a valid 16-byte record. The adjacent 0Ah/44h Add case does not cover fragmentation.

ED-03 supplies standard semantics; ED-15 requires an exact oracle; ED-16 gates synthetic/fault side effects; ED-17 preserves SEL evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB/Add identities; ED-28/ED-30 require recovery; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Partial Add SEL Entry (IB 0Ah/45h) reserved multi-fragment assembly and readback
test_case.purpose: Exercise the standard in-band partial-add state machine with one authorized synthetic 16-byte SEL record split across multiple contiguous writes, prove the controller assembles exactly one correct record, and contain/retain its evidence without clearing history or replacing the test with ordinary Add SEL.
required_package: Approved BMC/firmware and local IPMI system interface; Get SEL Info showing Partial Add support, Reserve support state, no erase in progress, no overflow and sufficient capacity/allocation

Versioned synthetic 16-byte record contract with record type/length, placeholder Record ID/timestamp policy, software-owned generator/sensor/event semantics, exact expected decoded record and no prohibited PEF/alert/downstream match
Approved fragment plan of at least two chunks whose offsets start at zero, are contiguous, sum exactly to 16 and fit the interface; parser for reservation and returned Record IDs

Versioned runner for 0Ah/42h Reserve, 0Ah/45h state transitions and 0Ah/43h full Get SEL Entry, with one-shot fragments, no retry, concurrency monitoring and incomplete-sequence abort by a new reservation
Preserved SEL/last-record/capacity and downstream baselines, immediate confirmation before the sequence, exclusive/quiet repository window, retention-by-default and authorized recovery/verdict owner
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED MULTI-FRAGMENT SEL PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Preserve all SEL/log evidence; do not clear it. Read Get SEL Info, require Partial Add support, adequate free space and no erase/overflow; record last entry and downstream baselines. Validate the exact synthetic 16-byte record and at least two contiguous chunks. If Reserve is supported, send 0Ah/42h once and require a nonzero RID; otherwise use RID=0000h only under an approved serialized-access contract. After immediate confirmation, send first 0Ah/45h [RID_L RID_H 00 00 00 00 FRAGMENT_0] exactly once; require completion 00h and capture RETURNED_RECORD_ID. For every non-final continuation, send [RID RETURNED_RECORD_ID OFFSET 00 FRAGMENT] where OFFSET equals the total prior data bytes. For the last bytes only, use final nibble 01h. Require the same returned Record ID and contiguous offsets for the whole sequence. If any other SEL addition cancels the reservation or any response/offset/ID is wrong, stop without restarting. After completion, use full Get SEL Entry 0Ah/43h for the returned ID; require exactly one new 16-byte record, BMC-assigned ID/timestamp as specified and all remaining bytes equal the approved record; correlate allowed-only downstream effects. Retain the record by default. Never run the source one-shot payload, 0Ah/44h as a substitute, an arbitrary hardware sensor event, clear/delete SEL, retry or cold-reset.
test_case.expected_result: Capability and capacity prechecks pass. Each approved fragment returns completion 00h and one stable returned Record ID; offsets are 00h then exactly cumulative, non-final requests use 00h and only the final complete fragment uses 01h. No entry is exposed as completed before the final transfer. Full Get SEL Entry returns exactly one assembled 16-byte record: assigned Record ID and any standard auto-timestamp are valid, while record type, generator, sensor/event identity and data exactly match the synthetic contract. SEL history/capacity remain consistent and no prohibited downstream action occurs. Cancellation, C5h reservation error, 80h length mismatch, 81h erase state, gap/overlap, partial visibility, extra record, decoded mismatch or unexpected action is FAIL/NOT READY without retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact Source Key/variant, advertised 0Ah/45h support, correct reservation handling, at least two sequential fragments totaling 16 bytes, stable returned Record ID, exact final Get/readback, preserved repository evidence and allowed-only side effects. The source one-shot bytes, ordinary 0Ah/44h, command success alone, guessed Sensor Type, no reservation where supported, discontinuous offsets, retry after cancellation, SEL clear/delete, OOB evidence substituted for this IB identity or incomplete artifact cannot pass. N/A requires Get SEL Info or authoritative platform evidence that Partial Add is unsupported while the required alternative Add command is provided.
safety_gate: Use only the local interface for this IB identity; row 1198 OOB and row 1070 ordinary Add remain separate coverage.
Preserve SEL and verify support, capacity, last record, no erase/overflow, exact synthetic record and downstream no-action analysis before reserving or writing.
Use an exclusive/quiet SEL window. Any new event, new reservation, deletion, clear or BMC reset can cancel the reservation; treat cancellation as FAIL and do not restart automatically.

Validate each outgoing reservation ID, Record ID, offset, final nibble and fragment length. Reserved high bits of the progress byte are zero, and final is not asserted until total data reaches exactly 16 bytes.
Retain the completed synthetic record by default. Do not clear SEL or delete unrelated entries; any later exact-record cleanup needs separately preserved evidence and explicit authorization.

On an incomplete sequence, do not guess the next fragment. When pre-approved and safe, issue one new Reserve SEL to cancel/discard the partial state, verify no completed test record exists and hand remaining recovery to the owner; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/firmware/local-interface identity; official fragment-state authority; distinct row-1198 OOB and row-1070 Add identities
Raw/decoded Get SEL Info support/capacity/overflow/erase state, SEL baseline/last ID, approved 16-byte synthetic record and fragment table with offsets/final flags
Reserve response and every redacted 0Ah/45h request, completion, returned Record ID and monotonic timestamp proving one uninterrupted sequence
Full raw/decoded 0Ah/43h returned record with documented ID/timestamp masking and exact comparison of all other bytes
SEL count/capacity/history and PEF/alert/downstream observations, retained record or separately authorized exact-record cleanup evidence
PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A and engineer verdict, including any reservation cancellation/abort and explicit no DUT action by the review agent
test_case.recovery: Precompute recovery before the first fragment. If a fragment is rejected, the reservation changes, offset/Record ID diverges or the sequence cannot finish, stop and preserve the transcript; do not send the next or repeat any fragment. If authorized, issue one new Reserve SEL command to cancel the outstanding reservation so the standard discards incomplete data, then confirm no completed test record exists. If a completed record is wrong, retain it and escalate; do not clear SEL or delete evidence automatically. Never cold-reset, retry the sequence or append guessed bytes.

source_conflict.reason: Official section 31.7 resolves the fragment protocol: the review layer replaces the invalid one-shot record-shaped payload with Reserve plus contiguous multi-fragment assembly and exact Get readback, while preserving the original row as history.

blocked.reason: Capability, reservation, record-ID, offset, progress, discard and readback semantics are standardized. Exact synthetic record, split, quiet window and downstream controls are bounded Project package inputs.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 31.2, 31.4-31.7 and Tables 31-2, 31-4, 31-5 and 31-7 define Partial Add/Reserve support bits, reservation and cancellation, sequential offsets, Record ID, progress/final flag, discard before completion, assigned timestamps and full record readback.

project_authority: SEL/BMC owners approve the exact synthetic record and fragment plan, provide a quiet repository window, validate downstream containment and own retention/recovery/verdicts. They may use RID 0000h only when the platform authoritatively lacks Reserve and access is serialized. They cannot approve the source one-shot payload, ordinary Add substitution, guessed hardware identity, retry after cancellation, SEL clearing or incomplete sequence evidence as PASS.
